scope: PQ-049.01 source candidate; chase-camera evidence only; not wired

textureStrategy.format: planned portable embedded PNG in source GLB plus editable PNGs in textures/ after source implementation
textureStrategy.uvStrategy: The future builder must give each render mesh a deterministic, per-object UVMap projection. It is a planned way to bind portable role maps, not a G3 pass; checker/stretch review remains pending.
textureStrategy.materialModel: planned glTF metallic-roughness with per-role response rather than a recolored common shader
textureStrategy.wearRule: Wear is restricted to dock contact, tether contact, cassette latch, heat-throat, and service-handling regions; there is no global dirt layer.

visibleZoneRegister.functionOriginAndServiceContext: ART EXTRAPOLATION: formed passenger pressure shell maintained between dock calls.

visibleZoneRegister.interfacesLoadAccessAndHeatPaths: bulkhead stations carry the wedge, docking jambs, dorsal spine roots, and keel brackets; ceramic remains continuous across quiet plate
visibleZoneRegister.expectedOpticalResponse: non-metallic low-sheen coating; warm broad highlights with sparse local scuffing rather than plastic gloss

visibleZoneRegister.expectedOpticalResponse: dark satin frame with restrained directional highlights; translucent blue-grey glass distinct from painted or metallic surfaces
